info.name: TaskFlow API — Server Collection
info.description:
# 🚀 Algonive Task Manager — Backend API Collection

Complete Postman collection for **every route** exposed by the Express server (`server/server.js`).

## 📦 Coverage
| Folder | Prefix | Routes |
|---|---|---|
| 🏥 Health & System | `/api/health`, `/` | 2 |
| 🔐 Authentication | `/api/auth` | 8 |
| 👥 Teams | `/api/teams` | 6 |
| 📋 Tasks | `/api/tasks` | 11 |
| 🔔 Notifications | `/api/notifications` | 4 |
| 💬 Messaging | `/api/messaging` | 11 |
| **Total** | | **42** |

## ⚡ Quick Start
1. Import this file into Postman (**Import → File**).
2. Edit collection variables → set `baseUrl`, `email`, `password`.
3. Run **🔐 Authentication → Login User** — the test script automatically saves the JWT into `{{token}}`.
4. All protected requests use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically.
5. IDs (`teamId`, `taskId`, `notificationId`, `conversationId`, `attachmentId`, `resetToken`) are **auto-captured** from responses as you run requests in order.

## 🔁 Suggested Run Order
Signup → Login → Create Team → Create Task → Upload Attachment → Notifications → Messaging → Profile/Logout.

item.name: 🏥 Health & System
item.description: Public system endpoints for monitoring and API discovery. No authentication required.

request.description:
**GET /api/health** — Server health report: uptime, memory, MongoDB status, Redis status and connected Socket.IO clients.

Access: 🔓 Public

**GET /** — Welcome payload listing all top-level API endpoint groups.

Access: 🔓 Public

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, profile management and the full OTP-based password-reset flow. Login/Signup responses auto-capture `{{token}}` and `{{userId}}`.

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/signup** — Register a new user. Password is hashed with bcrypt (12 rounds). Returns a 7-day JWT.

Access: 🔓 Public · Rate limited (strict)
Validation: name 2–50 chars, valid email, password min 6 chars. Use `role: "admin"` + `adminInviteToken` to create an admin.

Auto-captures: `token`, `userId`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 (or 400 if user exists)', () => [201, 400].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/login** — Authenticate and receive a JWT (7 days). Account locks for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.

Access: 🔓 Public · Rate limited (strict)

Auto-captures: `token`, `userId` — run this first before testing protected routes.

**GET /api/auth/me** — Fetch the authenticated user's profile (without password hash) including populated teams. Cached 30 min.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**PUT /api/auth/profile** — Update the current user's name and/or email. Rejects emails already taken by another user.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**POST /api/auth/forgot-password** — Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email (valid 10 min, max 3 verify attempts). Response never reveals whether the account exists. One OTP request per 5 minutes.

Access: 🔓 Public · Rate limited (strict)

Next: copy the OTP from the email into `{{otp}}`, then run **Verify OTP**.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 429 if asked too soon)', () => [200, 429].includes(pm.response.code));
console.log('📧 Check the inbox for the 6-digit OTP and set the otp collection variable');

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/verify-otp** — Verifies the 6-digit OTP (6 digits, 3 attempts max) and returns a short-lived `resetToken` (15 min) used by Reset Password.

Access: 🔓 Public · Rate limited (strict)

Auto-captures: `resetToken`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 400 for bad OTP)', () => [200, 400, 429].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/reset-password** — Completes the password reset using the `resetToken` from Verify OTP. Both passwords must match (min 6 chars). Clears all remaining OTPs.

Access: 🔓 Public · Rate limited (strict)

After success: update the `password` collection variable and login again.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 400 for invalid token)', () => [200, 400, 500].includes(pm.response.code));
console.log('✅ password reset — password variable updated, login again');

request.description:
**POST /api/auth/logout** — Logs the logout event to the audit trail. JWT is stateless so the client discards the token.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

item.name: 👥 Teams
item.description: Team CRUD and membership management. Creating a team auto-captures `{{teamId}}`. Only the team creator (or an admin) may update the team or add/remove members.

request.description:
**POST /api/teams** — Create a team. The creator is automatically added as the first member.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `teamId`.

**GET /api/teams** — List all teams the current user belongs to (newest first), with members and creator populated.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `teamId` (first team) if not already set.

**GET /api/teams/:id** — Fetch one team with members and creator populated. Returns 403 if the user is not a member.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**PUT /api/teams/:id** — Update team name, description and/or color. Only the team creator is allowed.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 403 if not creator)', () => [200, 403, 404].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description:
**POST /api/teams/:id/add-member** — Add a registered user (by email) to the team and create a `team_invite` notification for them. Only the team creator or an admin.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Tip: signup a second user first and set their email in `{{memberEmail}}`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx for validation/permission)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**DELETE /api/teams/:id/remove-member/:userId** — Remove a member from the team. Only the team creator or an admin.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

⚠️ Replace `{{userId}}` with the **member's** user id (default variable points at the logged-in user).

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx for permission)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

item.name: 📋 Tasks
item.description: Task CRUD, dashboard stats, activity feed, status transitions and file attachments (25 MB max per file, 10 files per upload, stored under `server/uploads/tasks/`).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Implement login page",
  "description": "Build the login UI with form validation and error states",
  "team": "{{teamId}}",
  "assignee": "{{userId}}",
  "status": "pending",
  "priority": "high",
  "dueDate": "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "tags": ["frontend", "auth"],
  "checklist": [
    { "text": "Design the form layout", "completed": true },
    { "text": "Wire up the API call", "completed": false }
  ]
}

request.description:
**POST /api/tasks** — Create a task in a team you belong to. Assigning another member creates an in-app notification **and** sends a task-assignment email.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)
Status: `pending | in_progress | completed` · Priority: `low | medium | high`

Auto-captures: `taskId`.

**GET /api/tasks** — Paginated task list across the user's teams (admins see all). Supports status/priority/team/assignee filters, text search and sorting.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `taskId` (first result) if not already set.

**GET /api/tasks/stats/dashboard** — Aggregated statistics for the dashboard: tasks by status, my open tasks, overdue tasks and 30-day creation history.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**GET /api/tasks/activity/feed** — Recent task activity (created, status changed, assignee changed) across the user's teams. Cached 5 min.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**GET /api/tasks/:id** — Fetch a single task with creator, assignee and team populated. Accessible to team members, the creator, the assignee or an admin. Cached 15 min.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**PUT /api/tasks/:id** — Update any task field. Status and assignee changes are recorded in the team activity feed.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token) — team members, creator, assignee or admin

**PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status** — Quick status transition (`pending | in_progress | completed`). Marking a task **completed** notifies the creator/assignee in-app and by email.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 400 for invalid status)', () => [200, 400].includes(pm.response.code));

formdata.description: Select one or more files — max 10 files, 25 MB each

request.description:
**POST /api/tasks/:id/attachments** — Upload up to 10 files (25 MB each) to a task via `multipart/form-data`. Files are stored on disk and indexed in MongoDB.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token) · Upload rate limited

In Postman: Body → form-data → key `files` → type **File** → select a file.

Auto-captures: `attachmentId` (first file).

**GET /api/tasks/:id/attachments** — List all attachments of a task (newest first) with uploader info. Cached 30 min.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `attachmentId` (first attachment) if not already set.

**GET /api/tasks/attachments/:attachmentId/download** — Stream the attachment file back as a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`).

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

In Postman: **Send and Download** to save the file. Returns 410 if the file is missing from storage.

**DELETE /api/tasks/:id** — Permanently delete a task **and** its attachments (files removed from disk), activity records and cache entries.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token) — only the task creator or an admin

⚠️ Destructive: run this last in the Tasks folder.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 403 if not creator)', () => [200, 403, 404].includes(pm.response.code));

item.name: 🔔 Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications generated by task assignments, status changes and team invites. Real-time delivery happens over Socket.IO (`user:{id}` room).

request.description:
**GET /api/notifications** — Current user's notifications (newest first) with task and actor populated, plus an `unreadCount`.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `notificationId` (first notification) if not already set.

**PUT /api/notifications/:id/read** — Mark a single notification as read. Only the notification owner can do this.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**PUT /api/notifications/read-all** — Mark every unread notification of the current user as read in one operation.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**DELETE /api/notifications/:id** — Permanently delete one of the current user's notifications.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

⚠️ Destructive: run this last in the Notifications folder.

item.name: 💬 Messaging
item.description: End-to-end encrypted team & direct messaging. Clients encrypt with X25519 + AES-GCM; the server only stores ciphertext. Real-time delivery via Socket.IO events (`messaging:new`, `messaging:presence`).

request.description:
**POST /api/messaging/keys** — Register (or rotate) the current user's public encryption key for a device.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**POST /api/messaging/keys/lookup** — Fetch public keys for a list of user ids. Only returns keys of users you are allowed to message (shared team, admin, or self).

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**POST /api/messaging/conversations/direct** — Open (or return the existing) 1-to-1 conversation with a user. Direct messages are allowed only within shared teams (admins exempt). Retention: `7d | 30d`.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `conversationId`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 (or 500 if DM not allowed)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**POST /api/messaging/conversations/team** — Open (or return the existing) group conversation for a team you belong to. Retention: `7d | 30d`.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `conversationId`.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 (or 4xx without access)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**GET /api/messaging/conversations** — All direct conversations the user participates in plus all team conversations of their teams (most recent first).

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

Auto-captures: `conversationId` (first conversation) if not already set.

**GET /api/messaging/conversations/:id/participants** — Participants of a conversation with name, email, role, avatar **and their registered public keys** (needed to encrypt messages).

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx without access)', () => pm.response.code < 500);
if (data.participants) pm.test('Participants include public keys', () => pm.expect(data.participants[0] ?? {}).to.have.property('publicKey'));

request.description:
**PATCH /api/messaging/conversations/:id/retention** — Change message retention (`7d | 30d`). Only the conversation creator or an admin.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx for permission)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**GET /api/messaging/messages/:conversationId** — Fetch encrypted messages of a conversation (newest first) with cursor pagination via `before`.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx without access)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**POST /api/messaging/messages** — Persist an end-to-end encrypted message. Requires `ciphertext`, `iv`, `authTag` and a `recipients` array (one entry per participant the client encrypted for). Emits `messaging:new` over Socket.IO to the conversation room and each recipient.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201 (or 500 for access errors)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description:
**GET /api/messaging/search** — Filter messages in a conversation by sender and/or date range.

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

**GET /api/messaging/export/:conversationId** — Download the full conversation as a JSON attachment (conversation metadata + all messages, oldest first).

Access: 🔒 Private (Bearer token)

In Postman: **Send and Download** to save the JSON file.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 4xx without access)', () => pm.response.code < 500);
